result: A story begins in the dark. Not the absence of light, but the heavy, velvet curtain of the nebula, where dust and hydrogen clump together, whispering secrets of gravity, trapped deep within the silence between atoms. It starts slow, a hesitation, then a sudden, desperate pull inward. Pressure mounts against the core, a cosmic squeeze that turns gas into plasma and plasma into fire. For eons, it holds the line. Fusion fights gravity in a silent, luminous war. The star wakes, burning with the fury of a newborn god, spinning out gold and oxygen into the cold vacuum. It is the anchor of a system, the sun to worlds that dream of life. But balance is borrowed time. The fuel dwindles. The star swells, a bloated heart beating slowly now, painting the sky in reds and oranges. Finally, the collapse. Not a death, but an exhalation. It sheds its skin, scattering seeds across the galaxy, rich carbon and iron that will become worlds, bones, stardust, and stories. The light fades, leaving a white dwarf, an ember in the dark, waiting for the next whisper to gather. Somewhere, a rogue planet drifts, its atmosphere frozen, dreaming of a heat it will never know. The universe stretches, expanding the canvas of time, while the embers of dead stars glow with the promise of renewal. The dance continues, a spiral of creation and decay, endless and indifferent, yet fiercely beautiful. And so, in the grand tapestry, every end is just a quiet beginning. Eternal. Forever.
